format: foodpro-menu-ajax parsing. kind=parse: input {html, category, mealPeriod, hallTid, isoDate} -> MenuItem[] (parseCategoryItems). kind=menu: input {hallTid, isoDate, response} where response is the feed's JSON (period wire key -> category -> html) -> the flattened MenuItem[] fetchMenu returns, in wire-key order breakfast, lunch, dinner, 'late night' (period latenight), 'daily offerings' (allday), grabngo, then categories in object order. MenuItem optional keys price and ingredients are omitted when absent. nutrition.*Dv is a number, null (attribute present but blank) or omitted (attribute absent). Every case is {kind, name, input, expected}; expected is what shared/src (TypeScript) returns for input. JSON null = a value that is present and null. An ABSENT key = undefined / not set: implementations must treat a missing key and an unset field as the same thing, and must not emit null for it. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @udine/shared vectors`; never hand-edit expected.
